picks.title: Car seat & stroller safety picks
picks.summary: Ranked by independent crash testing (BabyGearLab sled tests, Consumer Reports), recall records and safety features. No U.S. government crash rating exists for car seats: NHTSA's stars rate ease of use, not safety.
caveats: Current NHTSA Ease-of-Use stars could not be retrieved for 2026 models; Consumer Reports crash grades are paywalled.
"No recall found" means targeted searches found none, not a confirmed clean record. Check your exact model number and manufacture date at NHTSA.gov/recalls.
Where Consumer Reports and BabyGearLab disagree, both are shown.

dates.label: Target car seat trade-in closes (20% coupon valid to Oct 17)
Seats made on or after this date must meet FMVSS 213a side-impact and 213b frontal rules (older seats stay legal)

picks.name: Nuna PIPA rx
picks.why: Lowest crash forces BabyGearLab has recorded (crash 9.0). Load leg + rebound panel, rigid LATCH, baseless belt install, FAA label. Fits the most compact strollers (TRVL natively; Minu V3, YOYO, Butterfly via adapter).

picks.name: Chicco KeyFit 35 / KeyFit Max
picks.why: Consumer Reports: 5/5 ease of use and 5/5 belt fit, one of the easiest seats to install correctly. Chicco states the Max meets FMVSS 213a + 213b; FAA label (Max).
flags: No confirmed adapter for most premium compact strollers

picks.name: Britax Willow S
picks.why: BabyGearLab Best Budget, crash 7.8, stability bar. Not part of the Aug 2026 Britax B-Safe handle recall.

picks.name: Clek Liing
picks.why: Wirecutter's rigid-LATCH pick; load leg; BabyGearLab reports better-than-average crash results.

picks.name: Graco SnugRide SnugFit 35 DLX
picks.why: Wirecutter's longtime top pick; 35 lb limit; anti-rebound bar. Graco says no other SnugRide is affected by the Turn & Slide recall.

picks.name: Graco Extend2Fit / Extend2Fit 3-in-1
picks.why: Most agreement across sources: Wirecutter top pick, Consumer Reports crash "Best" (3-in-1), BabyGearLab crash 8.5. Rear-faces to 50 lb, as the AAP advises.

picks.name: Graco 4Ever DLX
picks.why: BabyGearLab's top crash analysis (8.7), Best for Most Families. Only pick with verified NHTSA stars (2021: RF 4, FF 5, booster 4).

picks.name: Britax Poplar / Poplar S
picks.why: Consumer Reports 2026 Value Pick, "excellent crash protection"; under 17 in wide (3-across); rear-faces to 50 lb; 10-year life.
flags: Rear-facing recline may be too upright for newborns

picks.name: Chicco Fit360 or Graco Turn2Me (rotating)
picks.why: Fit360: Consumer Reports 2026 Top Pick with its highest crash rating, easiest install in BabyGearLab testing. Turn2Me: BabyGearLab crash 8.7 with among the lowest head-injury readings.
flags: Conflict: BabyGearLab rated Fit360 crash 7.1 (below average)

picks.name: Nuna RAVA Next
picks.why: BabyGearLab overall 80, crash 8.4; rear-faces to 50 lb. Recall 24C-002 covers only original RAVAs made before Oct 26, 2023.

picks.name: UPPAbaby Minu V3
picks.why: Only compact stroller at the top of both BabyGearLab (81, Best Overall) and Consumer Reports (top-rated lightweight, strong safety results). ~17 lb. Adapters for Mesa, Nuna PIPA, Maxi-Cosi, Clek.

picks.name: Nuna TRVL lx
picks.why: Consumer Reports recommended, 14.6 lb; original TRVL had BabyGearLab's best maneuverability (9.4). Nuna PIPA clicks in with no adapter.
flags: Fold exceeds cabin guidelines: plan to gate-check

picks.name: gb Pockit+ All-City
picks.why: Smallest fold BabyGearLab measured (score 73, Most Compact), 13.1 lb; includes Cybex car seat adapters.

picks.name: Stokke YOYO³ / Bugaboo Butterfly 2
picks.why: Cabin-size folds (13.6 lb / 16 lb); BabyGearLab rated the YOYO2 76. Both take Nuna PIPA, Cybex, Maxi-Cosi and Clek via adapters.
flags: YOYO³ parking-brake recall Nov 2024: check serial

picks.name: Chicco Bravo Trio (newborn travel system)
picks.why: Consumer Reports' top-rated travel system for newborns; KeyFit 30 clicks in natively.

avoid.name: Evenflo REO by Revolve360
avoid.detail: NHTSA 26C-004 (Jul 2026): headrest shifted in NHTSA's own crash test; 59,661 seats; no fix yet.

avoid.name: Graco SnugRide Turn & Slide
avoid.detail: NHTSA 26C-003 (Apr 2026): carrier may detach from base in a crash; free replacement.

avoid.name: Evenflo Revolve180 LiteMax NXT
avoid.detail: NHTSA 26C-005 (Aug 2026): recline indicator leaves baby too upright; repair kit expected Nov 2026.

avoid.name: Britax B-Safe Gen2 / 35 / Ultra, Endeavours
avoid.detail: Aug 2026: carry handle can partially detach; 114,660 seats; free clip kit. Fine in the car, don't carry by the handle.

avoid.name: Joolz Aer2 car seat adapters
avoid.detail: CPSC (Jun 2026): "false lock" lets the car seat fall; refund.

avoid.name: UPPAbaby Mesa V3 and Doona
avoid.detail: Lowest crash results in BabyGearLab's 2026 infant seat tests, despite Mesa V3's 213a claim.

avoid.name: Maxi-Cosi Emme 360
avoid.detail: Consumer Reports crash rating "Basic"; shell didn't stay well attached to the base forward-facing.

avoid.name: Unbranded or marketplace car seats
avoid.detail: Counterfeit seats sold on Temu and Amazon weren't certified for U.S. use. Buy from authorized retailers and check the FMVSS 213 label.
